{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "threshold": 99.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 500,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 5,
            "description": "5% penalty if availability impact is below 99%",
            "applicable_period": "monthly"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 30,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 300,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 3,
            "description": "3% penalty if initial response time exceeds 30 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_003",
            "metric": "RecoveryTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 60,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 200,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 2,
            "description": "2% penalty if recovery time exceeds 60 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "condition": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage < 99",
            "penalty_rule": "5% monetary penalty if availability impact is below 99%"
        },
        {
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 30",
            "penalty_rule": "3% monetary penalty if initial response time exceeds 30 minutes"
        },
        {
            "metric": "RecoveryTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "RecoveryTimeMinutes > 60",
            "penalty_rule": "2% monetary penalty if recovery time exceeds 60 minutes"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT IncidentID, CASE WHEN AvailabilityImpactPercentage < 99 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END AS Penalty_Availability, CASE WHEN InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 30 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS Penalty_ResponseTime, CASE WHEN RecoveryTimeMinutes > 60 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS Penalty_RecoveryTime FROM incidents_database_service WHERE SLABreached = TRUE",
    "data_fields_required": ["IncidentID", "AvailabilityImpactPercentage", "InitialResponseTimeMinutes", "RecoveryTimeMinutes", "SLABreached"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 10000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 10
}
